review_scope: Independent read-only source review, corroborated by existing diagnostic evidence; native execution gates are recorded separately
seam_equivalence_invariants: Fallback only follows ordinary degenerate-triangle failure; valid ordinary meshes keep the established path.
Original indexed surface must have exactly two opposing incidences for every edge, before any retriangulation.
Every seam has three distinct indices, exactly rational-collinear coordinates, and a middle vertex strictly inside its longest segment. Floating underflow alone cannot certify collinearity.
The longest seam segment must border exactly one surviving nondegenerate face. That face is partitioned at an existing vertex with its original orientation; no vertex is moved or welded.
Private repaired copy must pass ordinary strict solid validation and have exactly unchanged coordinate array. Open, nonmanifold, inconsistent and unsupported damaged surfaces remain inconclusive.
Face count, seam count and chunk budgets bound work; cancellation before/during repair cannot become a completed pass.
distance_invariants: All ordinary small-scene pairs preserve their exact queries and ordering. Only normalized-object pairs gain certified-distance bounds.
A pair is skipped only when its AABB lower bound certifies the requested gap/contact condition and cannot improve the best exact distance.
All possible gap/contact violations and the global closest valid pair therefore retain exact measurements; lower bounds use a separate nullable-distance representation.
Intersection volume is evaluated before accepting positive surface separation when AABBs overlap, preserving containment behavior.
Normalized-scene Manifold cache is local to one inspection, keyed by placed object index and bounded by a conservative64MiB LRU estimate.
